listings.name: CØNTRAST
listings.description: A lush East Austin oasis where private IR-sauna-and-plunge suites sit alongside a garden-style communal contrast area.

location.address: 1915 E Martin Luther King Jr Blvd #101, Austin, Texas, 78702

listings.name: The Ocean Lab
listings.description: A community-driven recovery hub near UT Austin stacking infrared sauna, cold plunge, float therapy, and PEMF under one roof.

listings.name: Melt Well
listings.description: A brand-new, ultra-private South Austin studio pairing infrared sauna, calibrated cold plunge, and medical-grade red light in your own suite.

listings.name: ULU Recovery & Wellness
listings.description: Bali-meets-Barton-Springs wellness studio with four private sauna-and-cold-plunge suites plus IV therapy and red light beds.

listings.name: Pure Sweat Studios
listings.description: South Lamar's only spot pairing a Sunlighten infrared cabin, cold plunge, and Epsom-salt float tank in one contrast therapy program.

listings.name: SWTHZ Belterra
listings.description: National contrast-therapy franchise offering private infrared sauna, cold plunge, and Vitamin-C shower suites in Southwest Austin.

listings.name: RESET on Third
listings.description: Billed as LA's lowest-cost contrast therapy, pairing a currented cold plunge with an infrared sauna in one private room.

listings.name: RVIVL
listings.description: Playa Vista's award-winning private-suite studio combining a full-spectrum infrared sauna with a Renu Cold Stoic ice bath and Aesop showers.

listings.name: Nordic Nirvana
listings.description: Norse-inspired boutique on the Cahuenga Pass with four themed private suites pairing traditional or infrared sauna with cold immersion.

listings.name: Club Contrast
listings.description: A communal Nordic sauna-and-plunge social club in Sherman Oaks built for ritual, not rush hour.

listings.name: Remedy Place West Hollywood
listings.description: The original Social Wellness Club on Sunset Strip, mixing guided ice baths and infrared sauna with IV drips, HBOT, and acupuncture.

listings.name: Sweatheory Hollywood
listings.description: Cedar-built infrared sauna pods with private showers on the Sunset/Cahuenga corner, plus cold plunge and infrared yoga classes.

location.address: 1503 N Cahuenga Blvd, Los Angeles, California, 90028

listings.name: Pause Studio Brentwood
listings.description: West LA's guided contrast therapy suite near Brentwood Country Mart, alternating infrared sauna and cold plunge on your schedule.

listings.name: Lore Bathing Club
listings.description: A phone-free NoHo bathing club offering a Finnish sauna, infrared sauna, and generous cold plunge in one unhurried 75-minute session.

listings.name: Othership Flatiron
listings.description: A 7,000-square-foot social sauna-and-ice-bath temple near Madison Square Garden built around guided breathwork classes.

listings.name: Elahni Speakeasy
listings.description: New York's first wellness speakeasy: an intimate four-person Finnish sauna and 39-degree ice bath ritual run by its founders.

listings.name: Recoverie
listings.description: A locally owned Brooklyn Bridge Park recovery club pairing dry sauna and ice bath with cryotherapy, red light, and IV drips.

listings.name: Bathhouse Flatiron
listings.description: A six-thermal-pool Manhattan bathhouse with dueling hot and cold pools plus Aufguss-guided dry sauna sessions.

listings.name: Continuum
listings.description: An AI-driven, ultra-premium West Village wellness club tracking wearables through cold plunge pools, Finnish sauna, and hyperbaric therapy.

listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: A big-box gym whose sauna has a genuine following — and a wellness area with documented maintenance problems, including past pool closures and mold complaints in reviews. The training floor is huge and the staff earn consistent praise, so the sauna's upkeep is the variable. Despite the name, this location no longer runs 24 hours.

listings.name: 360 Tans
listings.description: Primarily an airbrush tanning studio — 50-plus shades, eco-certified DHA solutions — that also lists infrared and red light services. It holds a 4.9 rating across nearly 700 reviews, with technicians praised by name for putting first-timers at ease. Come for the tan; treat the light therapy as the add-on.

location.address: 6203 N Capital of Texas Hwy Ste 350, Austin, Texas, 78731

listings.name: Bathe
listings.description: Austin's first bathhouse runs three distinct saunas, cold plunges at varied temperatures, a dipping pool, and a magnesium-enriched barrel soaking tub — with coworking space by day and private events after hours. Day passes and memberships both available.

location.address: 2922 E Cesar Chavez St, Austin, Texas, 78702

listings.name: Bouldering Project - Springdale
listings.description: Austin's big climbing gym hides a real contrast setup in the locker rooms: sauna plus cold plunge, included with a day pass or membership. Reviewers love the facilities but flag sauna etiquette — phones, skipped showers — as a recurring annoyance. Rated 4.8 across 1,866 reviews.

listings.name: Ceremony
listings.description: A plant-filled indoor-outdoor bathhouse with two cedar saunas, including a newer Finnish build, and cold plunges kept below 45°F. The $200 ten-pack is widely considered strong value, though reviewers flag confusing rules around group passes. Massage therapists on staff earn name-drops in reviews.

listings.name: Cold Plunge Austin
listings.description: A dedicated plunge-and-sauna shop built around private rooms: two infrared sauna suites with red light therapy (the Lava Room and Jungle Room) and two private plunge rooms held at 43°F. Walk-ins are accepted, though appointments are recommended.

listings.name: Dell JCC
listings.description: The sauna at the Dell JCC comes bundled with a community-center membership — fitness floor, classes, and pools included. It holds a 4.2 rating across 101 reviews. Best suited to members who want heat as one part of a broader routine, not a dedicated spa visit.

listings.name: East Communities YMCA
listings.description: A no-frills sauna inside the East Communities YMCA, where access folds into a standard Y membership. That makes it one of the cheapest ways to get regular heat exposure in Austin — expect functional facilities rather than spa polish.

listings.name: EvolvE
listings.description: A recovery studio whose signature trio stacks compression therapy, infrared sauna, and a cryotherapy chamber — regulars describe spending hours cycling through all three. Staff earn unusually personal praise, from the front desk tours to the practitioners. Membership is the best-value route if you go weekly.

listings.name: F45 Training Hilton Downtown
listings.description: This downtown F45 pairs its 45-minute functional training classes with a sauna for post-workout heat. Rated 4.9 across 49 reviews. A practical pick if you already train downtown; less compelling as a standalone sauna destination.

listings.name: Fitness Connection
listings.description: A 50,000-square-foot budget gym whose sauna members describe as 'heaven,' alongside women's-only workout zones, basketball courts, and a Kids' Club. Rated 4.4 across 2,332 reviews. The sauna rides along with a standard gym membership, making it one of the cheaper heat options in Austin.

listings.name: Generator Athlete Lab
listings.description: Structured 60-minute recovery sessions move you through infrared sauna, cold plunge, Normatec compression, vibration plates, and red light therapy with staff guidance. It holds a perfect 5.0 across 231 reviews. Built for athletes who want a protocol to follow, not just open access.

location.address: 800 W Cesar Chavez St PP120, Austin, Texas, 78701

listings.name: HOTWORX - Austin, TX - Lakeline
listings.description: A 24-hour infrared fitness studio where the workout happens inside the sauna: virtually instructed HIIT, Hot Pilates, Hot Yoga, and Hot Cycle sessions. App-based entry, consistently clean studios, 4.7 across 114 reviews. One caution: multiple reviewers report frustration with the membership cancellation process.

listings.name: Jacoby Plunges
listings.description: Founder-led cold exposure sessions built around a 1 HP chiller that pulls the water down to 37°F, with coaching aimed at getting newcomers past the mental barrier. The community — retreats, breathwork events, visiting wellness practitioners — is as much the draw as the plunge itself. Rated 5.0 across 29 reviews.

listings.name: Korrect Fitness
listings.description: One of the few Austin gyms with both a traditional sauna and a cold plunge on site, so members can run genuine contrast rounds between lifts. The 4.9 rating across 321 reviews is unusually strong for a gym recovery corner. Access comes with a gym membership.

listings.name: Northwest YMCA of Austin
listings.description: The Northwest YMCA's sauna is a membership perk rather than a destination — basic, communal, and covered by your Y dues. Worth knowing about if you live nearby; not a reason to join on its own.

listings.name: Öli Saunas
listings.description: Öli isn't a studio but a local builder: home saunas in Thermo-Spruce and Western Cedar, Huum heaters, and cold plunges, sold through an Austin showroom with design consults and code-compliant installation. Reviewers praise the no-pressure process and responsive after-sale support. The place to compare craft before buying from a faceless online retailer.

listings.name: Organic Bronze Spray Tanning - Airbrush Tanning Austin
listings.description: A Domain-area airbrush tanning salon with red light therapy on the service menu. Technicians are named in reviews for patient first-timer walkthroughs, and the 4.6 rating spans 177 reviews. Recurring complaints mention wait times and a membership-credit policy some guests find misleading.

listings.name: Palm Beach Tan
listings.description: Mostly a tanning salon — UV beds, spray tans, red light facials, massage chairs — with a full-spectrum sauna rounding out the menu. Rated 4.5 across 139 reviews, with staff product knowledge a frequent highlight. Cancellation complaints are the recurring negative theme.

location.address: 4815 W Braker Ln Ste 520, Austin, Texas, 78759

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Private full-spectrum infrared sauna suites, each with its own temperature panel, color light therapy, TV, and Bluetooth speakers, finished with a cooling eucalyptus towel. Two things to know before booking: there is no cold plunge, and showers are members-only. Rooms are repeatedly described as spotless.

location.address: 4404 W William Cannon Dr Suite C, Austin, Texas, 78749

listings.name: Restore Hyper Wellness
listings.description: The Mueller outpost of the national recovery chain pairs cryotherapy and infrared sauna with IV drips, NAD+, compression, and red light therapy. Rated 4.9 across 324 reviews, with no membership pressure and FSA funds accepted. A minority of reviewers dislike the scent of the cleaning products used on site.

listings.name: S W E A T L A N D
listings.description: An infrared-only studio with a genuine twist: lay-down SUITE saunas that keep your head outside the heat, plus upright CABANA options and a full-body red light room. You control the temperature and the music; cold towels and electrolytes are included. Note there is no cold plunge here.

listings.name: Sage Blossom Massage
listings.description: A massage studio first — therapists are praised by name across 752 reviews for intuitive, unhurried work — with infrared sauna sessions available alongside. Rated 4.9. Book it as massage with sauna time rather than expecting a bathhouse experience.

listings.name: Southwest Family YMCA
listings.description: Southwest Austin's family Y keeps a traditional sauna in the locker room wing. This is the budget play: heat access folded into a family membership, with the expected trade-offs of shared space and busy evenings.

listings.name: SWEATCITY Mobile Health and Recovery
listings.description: SWEATCITY flips the model — it's a mobile outfit, so the sauna and cold plunge come to your home, gym, or event rather than the other way around. No storefront to visit; you book the rig and they set it up.

listings.name: Townlake YMCA
listings.description: Austin's flagship Y on Town Lake includes a traditional sauna among its amenities. Membership also covers one of the better-located gym floors in the city, with the hike-and-bike trail right outside the door.

location.address: 1100 W Cesar Chavez St, Austin, Texas, 78703

listings.name: True REST Float Spa • Austin North
listings.description: A float-first spa — pods holding over 1,000 pounds of dissolved Epsom salt at skin temperature — that begins sessions with a sauna-and-ice-bath contrast round. Tea bar, oxygen bar, and prep rooms on site. Most reviews glow, though a few mention occasional pod cleanliness lapses.

location.address: 10721 Research Blvd Suite B-170, Austin, Texas, 78759

listings.name: YTX - YTX Yoga, Strength, Pilates, & HIIT Training
listings.description: YTX is a yoga, strength, Pilates, and HIIT studio first — the infrared sauna is the recovery bonus members use after class. The workouts carry a 4.7 rating across 437 reviews. Treat the sauna as a strong perk rather than the main event.

listings.name: America's Steam, Sauna & Spas
listings.description: Not a bathhouse — this family-run crew repairs, maintains, and installs residential steam saunas and steam showers, servicing brands like Amerec and Mr. Steam. Technicians Jim and Alex get praised for honest, no-pressure consultations and maintenance tips. Rated 4.7 across 14 reviews.

listings.name: BIÂN | A Luxury Private Club
listings.description: A members-only club where the standout is a steam room with an integrated cold plunge, backed by an infrared sauna, cryotherapy, 20-plus daily classes, and 10,000 square feet of coworking space. The restaurant and spa make it an all-day proposition. Rated 4.7 across 32 reviews.

location.address: 600 W Chicago Ave Suite 001, Chicago, Illinois, 60654

listings.name: Bijou Body Spa
listings.description: Owner Trina — a nurse by training — runs this spa's infrared sauna alongside cellulite-reduction treatments, with honest evaluations of which service fits each guest. Reviewers highlight the spotless facilities and her health-first advice. Rated 4.9 across 33 reviews.

listings.name: Biolife Organic Spa
listings.description: Skincare leads at this Ashland Avenue spa — microdermabrasion, dermaplaning, and microneedling from owner Ewa and her team, using her own product line — with infrared sauna sessions supporting the wellness side. Recently expanded into a larger space. Rated 4.8 across 116 reviews.

listings.name: CHICAGO BATH HOUSE
listings.description: Chicago's Russian-style bathhouse runs seriously hot — guests clock the traditional sauna between 228°F and 242°F — with an ice-cold plunge pool and a restaurant serving borscht and blintzes. Two warnings from reviewers: the admission fee isn't always clear upfront, and front-desk service can be gruff. Rated 4.4 across 959 reviews.

listings.name: Chicago CryoSpa
listings.description: The claim to fame is what the spa calls Chicago's coldest cryotherapy chamber — three-minute sessions — paired with a guest-favorite infrared sauna for a full hot-cold rotation. Red light, cryo-facials, and myofascial massage fill out the menu. Rated 4.9 across 85 reviews.

listings.name: Chicago Internal Cleansing
listings.description: Ozone sauna therapy and far-infrared sweat beds anchor the detox menu here, with guests reporting deeper sleep as the standout benefit. Colonic hydrotherapy — including the self-administered Libbe system — is the other half of the practice. Rated 4.6 across 21 reviews.

location.address: 1 E Erie St Suite 510, Chicago, Illinois, 60611

listings.name: Chicago Wellness Club
listings.description: An Old Town sanctuary pairing infrared sauna sessions with private float tanks — most guests do the sauna first. The fireplace relaxation room with complimentary tea earns its own praise, though a few reviewers found some advertised amenities out of service. Rated 4.7 across 54 reviews.

location.address: 1513 N Wells St Floor 2, Chicago, Illinois, 60610

listings.name: Chuan Spa at The Langham, Chicago
listings.description: The Langham's full-floor spa offers a herbal sauna, dry sauna, Himalayan salt room, and heated loungers — all properly hot, per guests — before treatments rooted in traditional Chinese medicine. Over 40 services, including acupuncture and moxibustion. Rated 4.3 across 115 reviews.

listings.name: Contrast Hot + Cold
listings.description: Chicago's first communal hot-and-cold studio: large infrared saunas with red light and dedicated plunge tubs in a social main room, plus private rooms for one or two. Owners Braxton, Doug, and Brad coach newcomers through the intervals. Rated 5.0 across 78 reviews.

listings.name: Copper Wellness
listings.description: An integrative medicine practice where acupuncture from Dr. Madden and Dr. Mohr draws the loyalty — guests report real relief for back, hip, and hormone issues — with an infrared sauna on the broader menu. One caution: billing transparency complaints surface in reviews. Rated 4.9 across 88 reviews.

listings.name: Eastend
listings.description: Guided group contrast sessions — sauna, then plunge, repeat — in a loft space with tall ceilings and exposed beams, popular with marathon trainers. A salt room, red light therapy, and chromatherapy round out the circuit. Rated 5.0 across 185 reviews.

listings.name: GOAT Wellness
listings.description: Forty-five-minute private infrared suites that run genuinely hot, 90s-themed decor, and a Chicago Bulls bathroom — this downtown studio doesn't take itself too seriously. Cryotherapy and Endospheres lymphatic treatments share the menu. Rated 4.7 across 49 reviews.

listings.name: HOTWORX - Chicago, IL - River North
listings.description: Members describe the River North studio as 'therapy in motion': 24/7 access to private infrared sauna workouts — Hot Bands, Hot Warrior, yoga, cycling, rowing — in rooms they call impeccably clean. Staff like Gwynda and Jessica get thanked by name. Rated 4.8 across 49 reviews.

location.address: 676 N La Salle Dr Suite 2, Chicago, Illinois, 60654

listings.name: HOTWORX-Chicago, IL - Mt Greenwood
listings.description: The newer Mt. Greenwood sibling of the River North studio, run by the same ownership group, with a dozen-plus infrared workout formats and member contests to keep things lively. Early joiners locked in pre-sale VIP rates. Rated 5.0 across 8 reviews.

listings.name: Kingston Reflexology
listings.description: The draw is deep tissue and foot massage at prices reviewers call unbeatable — the sauna is a relaxing bonus rather than the headline. A couple of recurring caveats: occasional mustiness and cold spots in the facility. Rated 4.3 across 187 reviews.

listings.name: Kohler Waters Spa at Lincoln Park, Chicago
listings.description: The Lincoln Park location of Kohler's hydrotherapy-focused spa brand, with a cold plunge and traditional sauna listed among its thermal amenities. No review history on file yet — check the spa directly for current day-access policies.

listings.name: LA Fitness
listings.description: Many Chicago LA Fitness clubs include a traditional sauna in the locker rooms, bundled with the pools, courts, and class schedule of a standard membership. Condition and availability vary club to club — verify at your nearest location before joining for the heat.

listings.name: Lian56
listings.description: A large, lavishly decorated downtown spa built around a steam sauna, hot jacuzzi, and table shower services. Convenient to the interstates; a staffer named Joy earns specific praise. Rated 5.0 across 2 reviews — a thin sample, so temper expectations accordingly.

listings.name: Life Time
listings.description: Life Time's Chicago-area clubs pair traditional saunas with cold plunge access inside a resort-scale athletic membership — pools, cafes, and extensive programming included. It sits at the premium end of gym pricing; tour your local club first.

location.address: 15 W Chicago Ave, Chicago, IL 60654, Chicago, Illinois, 60654

listings.name: Lost Language
listings.description: This Chicago listing advertises both a traditional sauna and cold plunge for contrast sessions. With no review history on file yet, treat the details as unconfirmed and ask about formats and pricing directly.

listings.name: Luminere Esthetics and Wellness
listings.description: Lakeview esthetics studio founded by Tracey Briggs, whose custom facials have kept clients loyal for years — brow work and massage join the appointment book, with infrared sauna and red light as add-ons. Expect a warm, unhurried room. Rated 4.7 across 126 reviews.

listings.name: Next Health Lincoln Park - Chicago
listings.description: A health-optimization center where a red light sauna and cryotherapy handle the hot-cold pairing, surrounded by IV drips, EBOO therapy, biomarker testing, and plasma exchange. Nurse Sally earns mentions for putting first-timers at ease. Rated 4.9 across 107 reviews.

listings.name: Peak Saunas
listings.description: A sauna retailer, not a bathhouse: Canadian red cedar units — traditional, infrared, and hybrid — with low-EMF heaters and WiFi controls, sized from solo to six-plus. Product quality gets raves, but multiple buyers report post-sale support going quiet. Rated 3.7 across 3 reviews.

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Private full-spectrum infrared suites with built-in red light panels and a chilled towel finish; introductory sessions run $20. Two policies to know: no cold plunge on site, and no back-to-back sessions allowed. Billing experiences in reviews are mixed. Rated 4.9 across 51 reviews.

listings.name: Reiki Klubhouse Holistic Healing Sanctuary & Spa
listings.description: Practitioner Mahogani Phreedom's healing sanctuary, where Reiki sessions, chakra work, yoni steams, and hydrotherapy baths draw guests describing the space as genuinely transformative. Herbal products and specialty teas go home with you. Rated 5.0 across 29 reviews.

listings.name: Restore Hyper Wellness
listings.description: The Lincoln Park outpost of the national recovery chain — infrared sauna held at a comfortable heat, cryotherapy, red light, compression, and IV therapy, with fully stocked showers after. General Manager Carol's team gets named repeatedly. Rated 4.8 across 51 reviews.

listings.name: Spa InterContinental Chicago
listings.description: Two Finnish saunas sit in the locker rooms of this three-level hotel spa, and the junior Olympic pool is a genuine perk — but reviewers report upkeep problems, including broken lockers and one cockroach sighting. Massage quality varies widely by therapist. Rated 2.8 across 14 reviews.

listings.name: SpaSpace Chicago
listings.description: A wellness hub on the west edge of the Loop where the infrared sauna is most often booked as the post-massage wind-down. Therapists Michael, Katrina, and Javier earn the loudest praise, and the post-service tea is a signature touch. Rated 4.6 across 400 reviews.

listings.name: SweatHouz Old Town Chicago Contrast Therapy Studio
listings.description: The Old Town studio of the SweatHouz franchise runs private contrast suites: infrared sauna, cold plunge, and a vitamin-C shower, all behind your own door. It's the stronger-reviewed of Chicago's two locations. Rated 4.8 across 105 reviews.

listings.name: SweatHouz West Loop Contrast Therapy Studio
listings.description: Same private-suite SweatHouz format — infrared sauna, plunge, vitamin-C shower — in the West Loop, but the review trail is thinner and cooler than Old Town's. Worth comparing both locations before committing to a pack. Rated 3.6 across 15 reviews.

listings.name: The CryoBar
listings.description: A cryotherapy-first studio where infrared sauna sessions handle the heat side of the recovery equation. Rated 4.8 across 155 reviews, with the review volume concentrated on the cryo experience — ask about sauna formats when booking.

listings.name: The Earth | Reflexology • Spa
listings.description: Important caveat first: despite this listing's amenities, reviewers say there is no sauna on premises — the focus is massage and reflexology, with a table shower before treatments. Pricing draws complaints about upsells beyond the posted $80 house fee. Rated 3.2 across 19 reviews.

listings.name: Thunder Domes - Custom Sauna Builders
listings.description: A custom cedar sauna builder based on Fulton Street, best known to the public for its mobile wood-fired sauna stationed at North Avenue Beach. American-made craftsmanship earns the praise; they also build prefab units for private clients. Rated 3.5 across 4 reviews.

listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: The sauna and steam room at this big-box gym come with a standard membership — but read recent reviews before counting on the wet area, which draws recurring complaints about hot tub cleanliness and out-of-order equipment. Weekday 24-hour access and a huge training floor are the real draws. Rated 3.7 across 911 reviews.

listings.name: 5 Star Salt Caves Wellness Center
listings.description: Private infrared sauna rooms preset to 150°F with color light therapy — note the temperature isn't adjustable, and there's no cold plunge on site. The signature attraction is the salt cave itself, where guests stretch out on salt crystals in dim light. Massage therapists here are praised by name. Rated 4.7 across 331 reviews.

listings.name: Airie Apartments
listings.description: A residential complex that lists a traditional sauna among its amenities — though residents consistently report it has never actually been operational. Treat it as an apartment listing rather than a usable sauna option. Access to the off-site Tava gym is the more reliable perk.

listings.name: Aria Integrative Health
listings.description: Full-spectrum infrared sauna sessions share the menu with red light therapy, laser treatments, and the EXOMIND mental wellness system at this med-spa style clinic. Owner Nick and team get repeated credit for building personalized treatment plans rather than selling one-off sessions. Rated 4.7 across 213 reviews.

listings.name: Atwood Therapeutics
listings.description: A RiNo massage studio with a private sauna and cold plunge downstairs, so you can run contrast rounds before or after bodywork. Therapists Shadé, Nolan, and Jonah are named in reviews for tailoring sessions to specific pain points. Perfect 5.0 across 41 reviews.

listings.name: beem® Light Sauna - RiNo
listings.description: Bigger than the usual single-person pods, beem's social-style infrared rooms end with an optional cold shower for a DIY contrast finish. Cooling mint towels and red light beds round out the visit, and guests keep using the word 'spotless.' Rated 5.0 across 46 reviews.

listings.name: Beyond Body Sculpting
listings.description: Owner Jackie builds treatments around the dry sauna: it follows the castor oil wrap in the signature Cleopatra Detox & Sculpt ritual, and regulars pair it with lymphatic drainage massage. A small, appointment-driven studio — 5.0 across 15 reviews.

location.address: 5777 E Evans Ave Ste 5, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Chuze Fitness
listings.description: Infrared sauna plus steam room for the price of a budget gym membership — that's the Chuze proposition in Goldsmith. The wet area is well-kept off-peak but turns into a social scene during rush hours. Rated 4.3 across 1,263 reviews.

location.address: 2253 S Monaco St Pkwy, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Colorado Athletic Club Monaco
listings.description: Gender-specific saunas and steam rooms anchor each locker room of this sprawling 1960s athletic club, which also runs a full tennis program. The building shows its age, but the locker rooms are consistently called spotless. Rated 3.5 across 129 reviews.

location.address: 2695 S Monaco St Pkwy, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Colorado Athletic Club Tabor Center/16th Street
listings.description: Downtown's 16th Street Mall location with a dry sauna and steam room members describe as clean and well-maintained — though the hot tub and the cancellation process both draw fire. Expect $100-plus monthly dues plus parking. Rated 3.6 across 251 reviews.

listings.name: Denver Mobile Sauna
listings.description: The sauna comes to you: a cabin-style mobile unit with a bubble window for natural light, plus a portable cold plunge, delivered and set up at homes, gyms, and events. Hosts Micah and Austin handle towels, teas, and timing. Rated 5.0 across 7 reviews.

listings.name: Denver Sports Recovery
listings.description: Primarily a sports-recovery clinic — chiropractic, dry needling, massage — that adds a dry sauna and cold plunge for contrast work. One caveat surfaces repeatedly: reviewers flag an odor problem in the sauna. Rated 4.9 across 383 reviews.

listings.name: Denver Zen Den
listings.description: Private sauna and cold plunge sessions in Jefferson Park, booked for individuals, couples, or small groups. The wildcard offering is the Lucia No°3 stroboscopic light experience, which guests describe as a sober psychedelic journey. Rated 5.0 across 48 reviews.

listings.name: Downtown Denver YMCA
listings.description: Membership or a day pass covers the traditional sauna and steam room at the downtown Y. Reviews are warmest about the classes and community services; membership-discount fine print is the common gripe. Rated 3.8 across 141 reviews.

listings.name: Dryden
listings.description: A Golden Triangle residential tower whose amenity floor includes a sauna, cold plunge, steam room, and a 19th-floor rooftop pool with city views. Residents love the setup but report intermittent closures of the thermal amenities. For tenants, not the public.

listings.name: Elixir Mind Body Massage
listings.description: The standard move at this massage studio: a 3-in-1 infrared sauna session before your table time, with the option to finish in the Polar Blaze cold plunge. A monthly massage subscription keeps regulars coming back. Rated 4.8 across 372 reviews.

location.address: 1518 Wazee St Suite A, Denver, Colorado, 80202

listings.name: Fit House Denver
listings.description: A group-fitness gym whose recovery corner — infrared sauna plus a cold plunge held at 38-39°F — gets used as seriously as the barbells. Members praise the transparent pricing and zero cancellation drama. Perfect 5.0 across 133 reviews.

listings.name: FoundryLine
listings.description: A RiNo apartment building whose residents' gym includes a traditional sauna and steam room, described by tenants as a genuinely luxurious touch. The rooftop pool, A Line access, and dog run round out the package. Residential access only.

listings.name: Garden Sauna Denver
listings.description: A single wood-fired barrel sauna in a backyard-style garden setting, paired with very cold garden tub plunges. The sauna interior is deliberately unlit — atmospheric by day, pitch black after dark. Owner Collin built the space himself and it shows. Rated 4.8 across 34 reviews.

listings.name: House of Motion Chiropractic
listings.description: Patients at Dr. Joe Chambers' chiropractic office top off adjustments with the infrared sauna and cold plunge. Care plans extend into curated exercises and mobility work — and the office dog, Keiba, gets his own mentions. Rated 5.0 across 84 reviews.

listings.name: Icelandic Fitness and Recovery
listings.description: Infrared saunas share the floor with hyperbaric oxygen chambers — a rare combination that members use for post-surgery and injury recovery. Owner Jason Stone is known for checking in mid-session, and reviewers call the pricing the best in Denver for these modalities. Rated 5.0 across 77 reviews.

location.address: 600 S Holly St Unit 104, Denver, Colorado, 80246

listings.name: JCC Fitness & Aquatics Center
listings.description: Inside the men's locker room: a dry sauna, steam room, and hot tub — when they're working, which members say isn't always. The renovated marble locker rooms and indoor-outdoor pools soften the blow, and day passes run $35. Rated 4.4 across 88 reviews.

listings.name: Juliana Duran | Brazilian Lymphatic Drainage Massage
listings.description: Sessions at this Cherry Creek studio start in a hot infrared sauna to loosen up before Juliana's Brazilian lymphatic drainage work — a technique reviewers insist she's mastered. Expect Aesop products, complimentary tea, and free garage parking. Rated 4.9 across 36 reviews.

listings.name: Lake Steam
listings.description: Denver's old-school Russian bathhouse: a multi-level cedar dry sauna, a eucalyptus-infused Turkish steam room, and separate men's and women's days. The $30 day pass is widely called the best shvitz deal in town, and the massages are priced lower than anywhere nearby. Rated 4.5 across 547 reviews.

listings.name: Lions Den Strength Mobility Performance
listings.description: A strength-and-mobility gym whose recovery room — traditional sauna plus an ice bath available essentially anytime — comes with the Base Plus membership tier. A dual membership with the adjacent Fusion Combat Training Center knocks 20% off each. Rated 5.0 across 70 reviews.

location.address: 5058 S Syracuse St Unit 10, Denver, Colorado, 80237

listings.name: LoHi Athletic Club
listings.description: A 24-hour neighborhood gym in the Highlands where the traditional sauna is a monthly add-on rather than an included perk — members still call it reasonably priced. Uncrowded compared to the chains, with a social regulars' scene. Rated 4.5 across 101 reviews.

listings.name: Martin Luther King Jr. Recreation Center
listings.description: Park Hill's rec center pairs a traditional dry sauna with a genuinely loved warm therapy pool — two depths, grab bars, kept very warm. Access runs through the city recreation membership, making this one of Denver's most affordable heat options. Rated 4.5 across 267 reviews.

listings.name: NAOSU SAUNA
listings.description: A three-level wooden sauna held at 185°F and up, flanked by five cold plunge tubs — three indoor, two outdoor barrels around 60°F. Sessions end with a tea service on the patio, and owner Jerry is often the one giving the tour. Rated 4.9 across 58 reviews.

listings.name: Nurture • The Wellcare Marketplace
listings.description: Part wellness marketplace, part coworking space, part café — with a Portal sauna that hits 210°F and a cold plunge that a loyal crew of regulars treats as a daily ritual. Fast WiFi and mostly gluten-free café food make it easy to stay for hours. Rated 4.3 across 107 reviews.

listings.name: Oakwell Beer Spa Denver
listings.description: Nowhere else in Denver runs this sequence: private infrared sauna, cold shower, then a beer-infused bath — with a self-pour wall of local craft beer in your room. Ninety-minute sessions are the popular pick, and it's a fixture for date nights. Rated 4.9 across 2,795 reviews.

listings.name: Ohana Yoga + Barre
listings.description: A Berkeley yoga and barre studio that happens to run a serious contrast setup: a Morozko Forge plunge at 37°F paired with an infrared sauna. Classes come first here — the recovery circuit is how members finish. Rated 4.9 across 147 reviews.

listings.name: Palm Beach Tan
listings.description: Upper membership tiers at this Baker-neighborhood tanning salon include Clearlight infrared sauna sessions. Staff get named in reviews for walking first-timers through the options without upsell pressure. Rated 4.6 across 550 reviews.

listings.name: PORTAL° Thermaculture
listings.description: Wood-fired saunas pushing 230°F, cold plunges that actually stay cold, and a West Highland patio scene that regulars treat as a second living room. There's a Boulder sibling location, and a popular coffee shop right next door. Rated 4.9 across 198 reviews.

listings.name: Pranava Massage
listings.description: Practitioner Landon's intuitive bodywork — including a synchronized four-hands option — is the draw at this RiNo studio, with a Canadian hemlock FAR infrared sauna available alongside. The art-filled space gets as much praise as the table work. Rated 5.0 across 189 reviews.

listings.name: Radiance Functional Medicine
listings.description: A membership-based functional medicine practice in Virginia Village where infrared sauna sessions support Dr. Tracy's treatment plans — hormone, thyroid, and gut health, with a perimenopause specialty. This is a clinical setting, not a drop-in sauna. Rated 5.0 across 18 reviews.

location.address: 1805 S Bellaire St Suite 310, Denver, Colorado, 80222

listings.name: Recovery Lounge & Spa
listings.description: Sunlighten 3-in-1 full-spectrum sauna sessions anchor treatment plans here that might also include PEMF, neurofeedback, craniosacral therapy, or lymphatic massage. Practitioners are praised by name for personalized care. Rated 4.9 across 91 reviews.

listings.name: Red Rocks Spa
listings.description: Private sauna suites for you or your party, plus a shared steam room and cold plunge for contrast rounds — all inside a woman-owned, family-run spa. Occasional reviews mention a murky plunge, so check the room before you commit. Rated 4.6 across 138 reviews.

location.address: 1842 S Parker Rd Unit 21, Denver, Colorado, 80231

listings.name: Reset Mind & Body - Denver (LoHi)
listings.description: A guided recovery circuit in LoHi: staff coach you through infrared sauna, stainless-steel cold plunge, compression boots, hot tub, and red light in a logical flow with no waiting. Guests report better sleep as the standout benefit. Rated 5.0 across 64 reviews.

listings.name: RÖK SPAS
listings.description: Steps from Union Station, RÖK claims the largest, hottest sauna in Colorado — Finnish radiant heat in a massive multi-level room — with cold plunges held at 48°F and a steam room on the circuit. No-shoes policy, memberships available. Rated 4.9 across 174 reviews.

listings.name: Sapa Spa and Wellness
listings.description: Solo or couples infrared sauna sessions at a gentle 115-135°F, plus something you won't find elsewhere in the U.S.: a Red Dao herbal bath served in copper tubs. Ginseng tea and a salt room complete the visit. Rated 5.0 across 66 reviews.

listings.name: Sesen Skin Body Wellness
listings.description: Facials, dermaplaning, sugaring, and Moxi laser come first at this skincare studio; the infrared sauna works as the detox add-on. Aestheticians are named in review after review, and the Hershey's kisses at the front desk get their own shout-outs. Rated 4.9 across 318 reviews.

listings.name: Studio CLMBR
listings.description: Disco ball, loud music, milestone boards — and a traditional sauna in the recovery room alongside compression boots and a Theragun. This climbing-machine studio charges $30 for drop-in classes. Rated 4.8 across 98 reviews.

listings.name: Summit Strong
listings.description: A free-weights-focused gym whose recovery room bundles an infrared sauna, steam room, cold plunge pool, and NormaTec sleeves — though some membership tiers pay extra for access, and day-pass visitors get in too. Classes are included in membership. Rated 4.4 across 210 reviews.

listings.name: Sway Wellness Spa Larimer
listings.description: The Remedy Room runs a tidy protocol — 20 minutes of sauna, 5 minutes of cold plunge — with compression boots and red light on the same circuit. Massages and facials fill out the menu, and members swear by the lounge. Rated 4.9 across 66 reviews.

listings.name: SweatHouz South Broadway Contrast Therapy Studio
listings.description: Private contrast-therapy suites on South Broadway run about 45 minutes in the infrared sauna, a vitamin-C shower, then the cold plunge — with a TV and streaming in every room. First sessions cost $40; note the $25 guest fee for a partner. Rated 5.0 across 106 reviews.

listings.name: Symmetry 360 Massage Highlands
listings.description: A Highlands massage studio where the 20-minute far-infrared-sauna-then-cold-plunge protocol has its own following. Monthly memberships make the routine affordable, and the therapist bench runs deep — six practitioners get named in reviews. Rated 4.9 across 1,116 reviews.

listings.name: THE Athletic Club
listings.description: A serious lifters' gym downtown with saunas in each locker room, hydro massage beds, and red light therapy forming the recovery circuit. Big windows, downtown views, and a weight-floor culture members describe as motivating rather than intimidating. Rated 4.9 across 326 reviews.

listings.name: The Cove Sauna and Cold Plunge
listings.description: Half sauna showroom in spirit, half recovery gym: a vibrational resonance sauna that plays your music through the bench, a salt halotherapy sauna, infrared and red light units, plus plunges at 40°F and 50°F. Owner Charlie walks newcomers through the whole circuit. Rated 5.0 across 56 reviews.

listings.name: The Helix Shop
listings.description: Not a bathhouse but a retailer: The Helix Shop sells traditional wood-fired and infrared saunas — with heaters from HUUM, Harvia, and Saunum — plus one- and two-person cold plunge tubs starting at $2,690. The Denver showroom is the place to compare equipment before buying.

listings.name: The Paramount
listings.description: A residential complex whose listed sauna is consistently reported broken and whose steam room draws cleanliness complaints. Between that and broader maintenance issues across the building, don't plan around the wellness amenities here. Rated 3.1 across 101 reviews.

listings.name: The Ritz-Carlton Spa, Denver
listings.description: The hotel spa's steam sauna and whirlpool are the pre- and post-treatment perks, open to treatment guests from 9 to 7 — locals can ask about the 10% weekday discount. There's no cold plunge, a gap reviewers specifically mention. Rated 4.3 across 51 reviews.

listings.name: The Town Center Collection
listings.description: Residents at this Central Park-area complex say the advertised sauna and jacuzzi spend long stretches out of service; the Olympic-size pool is the social hub when things are working. Rated 2.8 across 347 reviews — read recent resident feedback carefully.

listings.name: Traverse Fitness
listings.description: A custom cedar sauna and precision cold plunge anchor the recovery space at this ego-free training gym, which also runs a coworking area and free coffee. Coaches know members by name, and the community organizes events beyond the workouts. Rated 5.0 across 104 reviews.

listings.name: Upswell RiNo Station
listings.description: RiNo's active-recovery studio built around a 160-180°F traditional sauna and an in-ground cold plunge pool at about 55°F — big enough for a whole team to plunge at once. Compression units and PEMF mats fill out the recovery area. Rated 4.8 across 8 reviews.

listings.name: Upswell Studio South Broadway
listings.description: The South Broadway sibling goes pod-based: single or two-person infrared sauna capsules with chromotherapy, a 40-45°F plunge, and a warm 98-104°F soak for the full circuit. Yoga classes and NormaTec compression round out the membership. Rated 4.9 across 62 reviews.

listings.name: Urban Sweat Cherry Creek
listings.description: Both traditional and infrared saunas are on the menu at this Cherry Creek recovery studio, with tandem rooms for pairs. The popular 'triple combo' strings together lymphatic roller massage, sauna, and red light therapy. Rated 4.6 across 46 reviews.

listings.name: VASA Fitness
listings.description: A high-volume budget gym where the traditional sauna and heated Studio Red yoga classes come with a cheap membership — the trade-off is crowds at nearly all hours. Childcare and strong group-fitness instructors keep the rating at 4.0 across 2,563 reviews.

listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: Members consistently call out the sauna and steam room as the bonus that makes this big-box membership worth it, alongside a lap pool, turf zones, and a huge strength floor. The atmosphere gets praised as genuinely non-intimidating for beginners. Rated 4.5 across 2,123 reviews.

listings.name: ActIVate Drip Spa | Memorial
listings.description: IV hydration is the main event at this Memorial med-spa — drips like The Hulk for energy, plus boosters, facials, and body contouring — with infrared sauna sessions on the wellness menu. Dr. Tasha Roberts' team keeps most appointments under an hour. Rated 4.9 across 116 reviews.

listings.name: ALBI Wellness

listings.description: Private full-spectrum infrared suites with adjustable temperature, chromotherapy lighting, and an in-room iPad, finished with a cold mint towel. A social sauna room handles pairs and small groups. Red light therapy is the common add-on. Rated 5.0 across 104 reviews.

listings.name: Body FX

listings.name: Daily Dose Wellness Club
listings.description: Private infrared sauna rooms with Bluetooth audio and customizable light therapy, arranged so you can step straight into the cold plunge. Yoga and Pilates classes, IV vitamin therapy, and ClassPass booking round it out. Rated 5.0 across 69 reviews.

listings.name: De Premier Spa

listings.name: HBOT America
listings.description: Hyperbaric oxygen chambers are the specialty — guests use them for post-surgery and injury recovery — with infrared sauna sessions and leg compression alongside. location.address: 4544 Post Oak Pl Dr Suite 170, Houston, Texas, 77027

listings.name: HCU Bradshaw Fitness Center
listings.description: Both a dry sauna and a wet sauna come with membership at this university-affiliated fitness center, plus a steam room in the aquatics area. Full access runs around $140 a month — pricier than the chains, with a $20 day pass to try it first. Rated 4.6 across 119 reviews.

listings.name: Healthy Beautiful Body
listings.description: A small holistic medspa where the Hydrafacial is the star — guests rate it 10/10 for lasting glow — and the infrared sauna supports the detox side of the menu. Aesthetician Dee gets named for her informative, gentle approach. Rated 5.0 across 3 reviews.

listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston TX - Summerwood
listings.description: Manager Broc gets the credit for this Summerwood location's family-like feel — 24/7 virtually instructed workouts inside private infrared sauna rooms, from 15-minute HIIT to 30-minute Hot Pilates and Hot Yoga. listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston, TX - Clear Lake
listings.description: The Clear Lake HOTWORX pairs its infrared workout pods with something reviewers specifically remember: owner John freezing memberships without hassle during personal hardships. listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston, TX - East River
listings.description: Owners Ashley and Sergio run what multi-location members call the cleanest HOTWORX they've visited, with staff who make the format notably comfortable for introverts and the socially anxious. All the standard 15- and 30-minute infrared sessions are here. Rated 4.8 across 16 reviews.

listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston, TX - Energy Corridor
listings.description: Members at the Energy Corridor studio call its infrared units the 'best sauna' in the chain, and the 45-minute Hot Yoga session gets specific praise. listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston, TX - Heights
listings.description: Private infrared cabins around the clock in the Heights — members split between guided HIIT and isometric workouts and using the heat for solo meditation. The recurring caveat: the virtual class library can feel repetitive for daily visitors. Rated 4.2 across 39 reviews.

listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston, TX (Katy Green)
listings.description: The Katy Green studio follows the standard HOTWORX formula — private infrared workout rooms, 24/7 app booking, a separate weight room — but check recent reviews first: long-term members report slow maintenance on broken bikes, a showerhead, and a persistent odor. Rated 4.4 across 66 reviews.

listings.name: HOTWORX - Houston, TX (Memorial Villages)
listings.description: General Manager Christopher and his team get named for checking in on members at this Memorial Villages location, where the private infrared rooms are consistently called immaculate. The format suits people who want a focused workout without a gym-floor audience. Rated 4.3 across 33 reviews.

listings.name: HOTWORX- Houston, TX - Channelview
listings.description: The Channelview location earns 10/10 service marks in reviews — Aaron and Cam are thanked by name for thorough tours and painless sign-up. Members like the private infrared rooms for getting a full workout done in half the usual gym time. Rated 5.0 across 28 reviews.

listings.name: Houston's Sauna & Spa
listings.description: Private infrared rooms big enough for friends or family, with movies on during the session — guests report real relief for muscle pain and better sleep afterward. location.address: 903 Bay Area Blvd C, Houston, Texas, 77058

listings.description: The contrast room pairs two cold plunges with a sauna, and that's just one corner of a facility stacked with cryotherapy, hyperbaric chambers, Class IV laser, and NeuFit. listings.description: Choose your heat — infrared or traditional sauna at different temperature settings — then flip to the whole-body cryo chamber, which plays music while you freeze. listings.name: Initiate Vitality: Colon Hydrotherapy, IV Drip Therapy, Weight Loss, Wellness
listings.description: A brightly lit, cedar-wrapped dry sauna booked for private scheduled sessions — no steam, which guests note means no mold worries. listings.name: LA Fitness
listings.description: The LA Fitness chain includes a traditional sauna in many of its Houston clubs, folded into a standard gym membership with pools, courts, and a full class schedule. listings.name: Life Time
listings.description: Life Time's Houston-area athletic clubs include traditional saunas in their locker rooms as part of a luxury resort-style membership — think pools, cafes, and extensive class programming alongside. It's among the priciest gym memberships in the city; tour before committing.

listings.name: Löyly Sauna Lounge
listings.description: Traditional and infrared saunas feed into Houston's standout communal plunge: a large saltwater cold pool built for groups, with a saltwater hot tub to complete the cycle. listings.name: Luxury Mobile Sauna
listings.description: A delivery sauna service — they bring the unit to your home or event and pick it up after, with contact-free drop-off. Pitched at everyone from first-timers to sauna regulars who want the heat without the drive.

location.address: Mobile Services Self Care, Houston, Texas, 77033

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Private infrared suites with in-room TVs and a cold eucalyptus towel at the finish — but know the format: low-temperature infrared only, no traditional high-heat sauna and no cold plunge. listings.name: Prosperous Paradise Spa
listings.description: A massage and nail salon where, despite listings suggesting otherwise, reviewers consistently say there is no sauna for guests. listings.name: RISE Modern Wellness
listings.description: Owner Julie's studio pairs its infrared sauna with whole-body cryotherapy as the signature one-two, backed by salt sessions, PEMF, and red light facials. The team tailors plans to specific goals and schedules rather than pushing a fixed menu. Rated 5.0 across 79 reviews.

listings.name: Shape Room Infrared Sauna Spa

listings.name: SkinTite Body Spa-Houston
listings.description: A body-sculpting studio where infrared sauna sessions come bundled into Buttock, Cellulite, and Fat Loss membership packages of 20-plus sessions. listings.name: Street Side Sauna Co
listings.description: Wood-fired Nordic-style sauna practice in Houston, with cold plunge therapy alongside for the full contrast cycle. A newer entry with little review history so far — one for the traditional-heat purists to watch.

listings.name: Sudor Sauna Studio
listings.description: Forty-five-minute private infrared suites — you control light, temperature, and soundtrack — with a central cold plunge for contrast rounds; regulars run roughly 11 minutes hot, 3 minutes cold. location.address: 3515 W Dallas St Suite 400, Houston, Texas, 77019

listings.name: The Well House Collective
listings.description: An infrared salt sauna leads into cryotherapy for the house contrast combo, and the hyperbaric chamber is set up so you can actually work inside it. The concierge team tailors sessions for post-surgery recovery and chronic inflammation cases. Rated 5.0 across 32 reviews.

location.address: 2808 Richmond Ave. suite c, Houston, Texas, 77098

listings.name: Wendel D. Ley Family YMCA

listings.name: ZaSpa Houston Museum District
listings.description: Inside Hotel ZaZa, this spa's infrared sauna serves as the post-massage finish — accessed from the locker rooms after table work by therapists like Dina and Martha. Facilities are compact, and massage-only pricing strikes some as steep. Rated 4.1 across 49 reviews.

listings.name: 24 Hour Fitness
listings.description: A well-kept big-box gym where the sauna comes with the membership, alongside turf zones, a lap pool, and rows of strength and cardio equipment. Staff like GM Kip earn consistent praise; cancellation friction is the recurring complaint. Rated 4.2 across 1,644 reviews.

listings.name: Aroma Spa & Sports LLC
listings.description: Part gym, part Korean-style spa: steam, dry, clay, jade, and medicinal-stone sauna rooms plus hot, temperate, and cold pools across multiple floors. Body scrubs by Young get raves; the annual fee and strict no-refund policy do not. Rated 4.0 across 269 reviews.

listings.name: AWAKEN Wellness and Recovery - Cryotherapy, Infrared Sauna, Red Light Therapy and Halotherapy
listings.description: The play here is sequencing: cryotherapy, infrared sauna, red light, and compression stacked into one recovery 'pathway.' location.address: 18000 Chatsworth St # A, Los Angeles, California, 91344

listings.name: CEO2 Health
listings.description: Infrared sauna with built-in red light, an ozone-filtered cold plunge, and a four-person hyperbaric chamber — staff like Rachel stay with you through each session. Reviewers describe it as a one-stop recovery shop run at an unhurried pace. Rated 5.0 across 39 reviews.

listings.name: Crystal Korean Spa Los Angeles

listings.name: DESUAR DTLA Spa

listings.name: Evolve Sanctuary Pole and Infrared Sauna Studio
listings.description: Private infrared sauna rooms stocked with water, weights, and cold eucalyptus towels, with optional red light — and a pole fitness studio under the same roof. Owner Lani's team walks first-timers through everything. Rated 4.9 across 216 reviews.

listings.name: IconFit

listings.name: beem® Light Sauna Tampa - Ybor City

listings.name: Caribbean Mystique Massage & Wellness Spa
listings.description: Treatment rooms named after Caribbean islands, and therapists to match: Kindell for anatomy-deep sports work, Christie for mobility, Cristine for prenatal. Sauna and cryo amenities support the massage-first menu. Rated 4.8 across 421 reviews.

listings.name: Diesel Optimization
listings.description: A serious training gym whose recovery zone centers on a 12-person wood-burning barrel sauna at 230°F — always hot, with cold tubs always cold, per members. Red light, Normatec boots, and a protein-shake nutrition station complete the loop. Rated 5.0 across 60 reviews.

listings.name: Embers & Ice
listings.description: Guided 60-minute Nordic contrast sessions — sauna, cold room, breathwork, repeat — led by coaches like Daniel, Jo, Eric, and Adam. Regulars recommend the unlimited membership outright. Rated 5.0 across 7 reviews.

listings.name: Florida Float Spa Tampa
listings.description: Float therapy is the core, with infrared sauna, PEMF mat, and compression massage in support — at prices reviewers call very affordable. Minor quibbles: occasional chilly tank water and light leaking under pod doors. Rated 4.8 across 112 reviews.

location.address: 14405 N Dale Mabry Hwy, Tampa, Florida, 33618

listings.name: Heim Regenerative Medicine Center
listings.description: Dr. Michael Heim's regenerative medicine practice hosts Frequency Fridays at Fire and Frost: guided sessions between a cedar-scented sauna and self-cleaning, chemical-free plunge pools. Stem cell, exosome, and hormone therapies are the clinical side. Rated 4.8 across 132 reviews.

listings.name: Hot Box Cold Plunge
listings.description: A Nordic sauna-and-plunge studio next to Seminole Heights CrossFit, running instructor-led contrast sessions pitched at athletes and the merely curious alike. No review history on file yet — the CrossFit crowd next door is the built-in community.

location.address: 4423 N Florida Ave Suite B, Tampa, Florida, 33603

listings.name: Kodawari Studios
listings.description: A South Tampa yoga studio whose signature is the Kodawari protocol: three instructor-led rounds of sauna and cold plunge, with a popular Friday group session. The unlimited yoga-plus-sauna membership gets called amazing value. Rated 4.9 across 232 reviews.

location.address: 3965 Henderson Blvd Suite C, Tampa, Florida, 33629

listings.name: Perspire Sauna Studio
listings.description: Private full-spectrum infrared suites with the temperature pre-set to your preference before you arrive, chromotherapy, and a 'snow shower' for cold contrast without full submersion. TVs show nature scenes instead of blank walls. Rated 5.0 across 24 reviews.

location.address: 1155 S Dale Mabry Hwy Suite 16/17, Tampa, Florida, 33629

listings.name: Restore Hyper Wellness
listings.description: The Tampa Restore pairs its infrared sauna — one guest uses it within a Lyme disease detox protocol — with cryo, red light, NAD therapy, and a newly expanded IV menu. A nine-deep bench of named staff tells the service story. Rated 5.0 across 207 reviews.

listings.name: Shangri-La Bath & Sauna
listings.description: Tampa's authentic Korean spa: clay and salt saunas that run seriously hot (resting boards provided), a steam room, hot tub, and small cold dip — nude and phone-free in the wet area. Day passes run $33–35 with no time limit, and the on-site Korean restaurant cooks to order. Rated 4.3 across 657 reviews.

listings.name: SOHO Wellness & Med Spa | Tampa
listings.description: Visits open with a cozy infrared sauna session before facials, massage, Botox, fillers, or PDO threads. The lounge, robes, new-client specials, and birthday gifts are the small touches reviewers keep mentioning. Rated 4.8 across 619 reviews.

listings.name: The Body Lab
listings.description: Post-operative recovery is the specialty: contrast therapy cycles plus lymphatic drainage and fire cupping from therapists like Gavi and Lilly. Post-surgical guests report leaving moving freely. Rated 4.8 across 39 reviews.

listings.name: Triarii Fitness
listings.description: A private personal-training gym in Town 'n' Country — trainers Justin and Clarissa lead one-on-one functional strength work — where the dry sauna is members' favorite recovery perk and massage therapist Heather is on staff. Rated 5.0 across 23 reviews.

listings.name: Tummo Studios Tampa
listings.description: EMS workouts are the core product; the sauna-and-cold-plunge recovery package is the add-on members say eliminated their post-workout burn entirely. Coaches like Cat and Phill explain the EMS system patiently. Rated 5.0 across 26 reviews.

listings.name: Turtle shell UBR
listings.description: A recovery lounge with four two-person cold plunge baths at stepped temperatures, a soothing sauna, red light, and an infrared station — plus heated robes, espresso, and a hair studio under the same roof. Rated 5.0 across 35 reviews.
